title: I built a superhero dispatch game with AI art and AI coding agents: 150 heroes, 1,050 incidents
author: Fun_Tumbleweed_3682
selftext:
당신은 도시의 긴급 대응을 담당합니다. 사건은 마감일과 함께 지도에 나타나고, 어떤 영웅이 그곳으로 가야 하는지, 다칠 수 있으며 다음 호출에 불가능하다는 것을 알기에 어떤 영웅이 갈지 결정합니다.

AI 사용 방식:

예술: 영웅, 사건, 아이콘은 AI 이미지 생성으로 만들어졌습니다. 각 영웅은 네 가지 별도 이미지가 있는데, 일상과 강화된 전신 이미지, 그리고 각각의 프로필을 포함합니다.

코드: Godot 4.7로 C#으로 빌드되었으며, AI 코딩 에이전트와 함께 작업합니다.

밸런스: 스크립트된 헤드리스 런은 실제 게임 규칙을 따르기 때문에 조정할 수 있는 숫자를 제공했습니다.

가장 어려웠던 점은 150명의 영웅과 1,050장의 사건 이미지에서 일관성을 유지하는 것이었기에, 저는 스타일 규칙을 작성하고 프롬프트 기록을 남깁니다.

일관된 스타일을 유지하기 위해 일주일 넘게 스타일 문서를 개정했고, 결국 20페이지가 넘는 스타일 규칙 세트를 완성했습니다.

하지만 결국 GPT에 내재된 어색함을 해결하지 못했는데, 여러분은 어떻게 대처하고 계신가요?

11월에 스팀으로 출시됩니다: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5522590/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5522590/)

replies.author: Fun_Tumbleweed_3682
replies.body:
I’m not entirely sure what a "menu simulator" is, but I gather it implies a game that consists solely of interacting with menus.



If that’s the case, then it fell short of the vision I had in mind, which is a bit disheartening.



What I had hoped for was a structure similar to \*911 Operator\*, but centered around heroes; however, lacking any background in game development, I clearly failed to foresee these issues.



Thank you for your sharp and candid criticism.

comments.author: Super-Huckleberry733
comments.body: This might be interesting, but the city graphics are simply awful. Isometric rendering isn't necessary, of course, but it's just shoddy. 150 heroes isn't a number you could balance, even with AI and recurrent space calculations-wouldn't work.

replies.author: Fun_Tumbleweed_3682
replies.body:
Regarding the city graphics, I explored several different approaches.



I experimented with a style similar to \*Infection Free Zone\*, and even tried a block-based aesthetic reminiscent of \*Minecraft\*.



However, since my original vision for the atmosphere was inspired by the game \*911 Operator\*, I opted for this "flat" design. Now that it’s finished, I realize—regardless of my initial intentions—that the design doesn't quite fit.



I stuck with my original vision, but it seems I may simply lack a strong sense for design.



As for the 150 heroes—even I feel that’s an excessive number. I suppose I just got a bit too carried away with the novelty of using AI to generate images.



It wasn't until I read the comments that I realized this might be an issue. That said, scaling the number down now would fundamentally alter the overall vision I had for the game, so that’s not really an option.



Still, I appreciate the candid criticism.

comments.author: mythicbrainstudio
comments.body: That looks like AI slop to be honest.

replies.author: Fun_Tumbleweed_3682
replies.body:
It is only natural that you would perceive this as "AI slop."

Even I, having finished the project, feel that the game is quite lacking; I simply reached a point where I couldn't figure out how to develop it any further, no matter how hard I tried to think of a way forward—so I just stopped.

I’m not sure if I’m conveying this well, given the language barrier.

Regardless, thank you for your sharp and incisive feedback.

replies.author: mythicbrainstudio
replies.body: I mean this with best intentions.
